description: NEXTRO is a team passionate about space, science, and innovation. Our goal is to create creative and interactive solutions that make space exploration easier to understand and more engaging for everyone. We believe in teamwork, learning, and using technology to explore beyond Earth.
summary: NEXTRO presents ARES: The Last Outpost, an interactive educational game about exploring Mars. Players take the role of an astronaut sent to restore a damaged research outpost on the Martian surface. They must locate and repair a solar array, scan three geological samples, monitor oxygen and suit power, and return safely to the habitat beacon. The game features a top-down exploration environment, mobile joystick controls, interactive objectives, and resource management. It introduces players to the challenges of planetary exploration and the scientific activities astronauts may perform during a Mars expedition.
details:
ARES: The Last Outpost is a 2D Mars exploration game developed by Team Nextro.

Players control an astronaut exploring a research outpost on Mars. The main mission is to repair a damaged solar array, scan three scientific samples, monitor oxygen and suit power, and return safely to the habitat beacon.

The game features a top-down Mars environment, mobile joystick controls, interactive mission objectives, a mission timer, and resource indicators.

It is a browser-based game developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The goal is to introduce players to the challenges of planetary exploration and help them understand the activities astronauts may perform during a Mars expedition.
